Jody's first article for PC Gamer was about the <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/the-audio-of-alien-isolation/">audio of Alien Isolation</a>, published in 2015, and since then he's written about <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/why-silent-hill-belongs-on-pc/">why Silent Hill belongs on PC</a>, <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/10-years-on-recettear-an-item-shops-tale-is-still-the-best-fantasy-shopkeeper-tycoon-game/">why Recettear: An Item Shop's Tale is the best fantasy shopkeeper tycoon game</a>, and <a href="https://www.pcgamer.com/there-is-so-so-much-weird-shit-in-lost-ark/">how weird Lost Ark can get</a>.
